entries.title: Psalms 28:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> To You I will cry, O LORD my Rock: Do not be silent to me, Lest, if You [are] silent to me, I become like those who go down to the pit.

entries.title: Psalms 28:2
segments: Hear the voice of my supplications When I cry to You, When I lift up my hands toward Your holy sanctuary.

entries.title: Psalms 28:3
segments: Do not take me away with the wicked And with the workers of iniquity, Who speak peace to their neighbors, But evil [is] in their hearts.

entries.title: Psalms 28:4
segments: Give them according to their deeds, And according to the wickedness of their endeavors; Give them according to the work of their hands; Render to them what they deserve.

entries.title: Psalms 28:5
segments: Because they do not regard the works of the LORD, Nor the operation of His hands, He shall destroy them And not build them up.

entries.title: Psalms 28:6
segments: ¶Blessed [be] the LORD, Because He has heard the voice of my supplications!

entries.title: Psalms 28:7
segments: The LORD [is] my strength and my shield; My heart trusted in Him, and I am helped; Therefore my heart greatly rejoices, And with my song I will praise Him.

entries.title: Psalms 28:8
segments: The LORD [is] their strength, And He [is] the saving refuge of His anointed.

entries.title: Psalms 28:9
segments: Save Your people, And bless Your inheritance; Shepherd them also, And bear them up forever.
